description: Bring-your-own-database: move where this app stores its users' data (saves, rooms, community, tables; the registry of users, purchases and friendships follows) from Neblla's default store (community included, so its entries can then be queried with their own SQL) to the developer's own database, or back. Actions: "status" (current engine + migration progress: progress {phase, processed, total, left}, cost {reads, writes, bytes, credits} spent so far, pausedForQuota + resumesAt, lastMigration); "validate" (engine + config, tests the connection, changes nothing); "migrate" (validates again, then starts a 3-phase background migration of ALL user data — confirm with the developer first); "to_neblla" (leave their database: the same migration back to Neblla's store, ALL of it comes back, players, purchases and records included — confirm first; if their database does not answer it fails with store_unavailable and canStartFresh, and "to_neblla" with fresh:true then starts the app FROM SCRATCH on Neblla's store, discarding what waits for their database: only with the developer's explicit go-ahead); "cancel" (only before the last phase). Every migration of theirs, there and back, is paid from the app's quota (reads, writes and bytes moved, kind "migration"): when the quota runs out the copy pauses and goes on by itself after the daily reset (or a pack); the final short lock always ends and is charged. Engines and config: mongo {uri, dbName}, turso {url, authToken}, postgres {uri}, mysql {uri}. Credentials are stored encrypted and never returned. env "pre" works on the app's pre: by default it follows the app's database (and moves with it); migrating it gives pre a database of its own, and "migrate" with follow:true takes it back to the app's. Only for a pre with its own data (neblla_pre_data "own").

config.description: For validate / migrate: the connection settings of the engine

follow.description: For migrate with env "pre": take pre back to the app's database (no engine or config)

fresh.description: For to_neblla, only when their database does not answer: start from scratch on Neblla's store (their data stays behind, the retry queue is discarded)

name: neblla_byodb
